The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are traffic, bridge, tolls. The table has 4 columns. Attribution on the portal: New York State Bridge Authority. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
